subject: POC governance & procurement check-in — success criteria, owners, and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@stratusmedia.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@stratusmedia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC governance & procurement check-in — success criteria, owners, and next steps

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we draft the SOW: 

Summary of what Stratus wants to validate in the 4-week POC:
- Latency: tail latency < 250ms for user-facing generation at 99th pct with 512 token average usage.
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions during peak tests (video ad personalization workload).
- Cost-efficiency: cost per 1k generated tokens <= target we discussed (you mentioned benchmark range).
- Data controls: ensure logs and payloads are retained only per your retention policy (14 days) and encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys.

Owners we discussed (please confirm):
- Infra / Hosting & Network: Stratus infra team (Tom Park) for connectivity and firewall rules; Redwood SE (Dylan Brooks) for endpoint & routing.
- Application integration: Stratus app owner (Alicia) + Redwood (Karthik) for SDK and template prompts.
- Security & Compliance: Stratus security to evaluate SOC2 evidence; Redwood security contact is Stephanie (cc’d on this thread).
- Procurement / Legal & Billing: Stratus procurement contact (Tom) and Redwood Sales (Marissa).

Proposed immediate next actions (week 0):
1) Stratus to share the minimal test corpus and sample prompts (attachment: stratus_poc_requirements.xlsx).
2) Redwood to provide a draft SOW and access plan (attachment: redwood_draft_sow_v1.pdf).
3) Security questionnaire kickoff: Stephanie to send SOC2 gap list (soc2-gap-questions.docx) and schedule a 30-min review with your security team.
4) Procurement: Marissa to open HubSpot deal and circulate commercial checklist.

Timeline suggestion:
- Week 0: access & connectivity validated, SOW signed.
- Week 1: smoke tests & baseline latency.
- Weeks 2–3: workload ramp, acceptance tests.
- Week 4: final evaluation and decision meeting.

Can you two confirm the owners above and whether the timeline looks reasonable? If approved, Marissa and I will convert the draft SOW to an execution-ready version and loop legal/procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment stubs: stratus_poc_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_draft_sow_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@stratusmedia.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Park <tom.park@stratusmedia.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC governance & procurement check-in — success criteria, owners, and next steps

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming owners from our side:
- Application owner: Alicia Gomez (me).
- Infra/network: Tom Park — he’ll own the VPN peering and the firewall/IP allowlist.
- Security: I’ll introduce you to our security lead, Priya N. (cc’d after this reply).
- Procurement: Tom will route commercial items to procurement@stratusmedia.com (Tom is the OPO).

The success criteria look good; only ask is to change retention to 30 days for the trial (we can evaluate shorter retention later). The timeline seems achievable but can we build a 2-day buffer between Week 1 smoke test and ramp given our internal change windows?

I’ll attach the sample prompts and a small test corpus in a follow-up email (sensitive data omitted). Looking forward to the SOC2 artifacts — our security will be keen to see keys/rotation details.

Alicia
Director, Product & Personalization
Stratus Media
agomez@stratusmedia.com | +1 212-555-0199

Date: 2027-04-10T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: POC governance & procurement check-in — SOW & commercial checklist

Tom / procurement team —

Looping you in to start the procurement checklist. Attached is the initial commercial summary and SOW outline (redwood_draft_sow_v1.pdf). High-level commercial points we expect for the 4-week POC: 
- Trial credit: up to $5k usage-credit for the POC period (applied post-SOW signature).
- Billing: one-time pilot invoice if you prefer; otherwise we can put usage on net-30 terms after POC.
- IP / data terms: standard POC terms (no retention beyond agreed window; data used to improve service only with explicit consent).

Please confirm which commercial route procurement prefers (credit vs invoice) and whether we need to route through a PO number. If procurement prefers a PO, Marissa will coordinate with Finance for net-30 setup.

Stephanie — can you attach the SOC2 excerpt and the rotation/KMS note? That will help accelerate the security review.

Next steps for owners / RACI: 
- Responsible: Stratus infra (Tom) for connectivity; Redwood SE (Karthik) responsible for endpoint access & template integration.
- Accountable: Alicia (app owner) for acceptance criteria sign-off.
- Consulted: Redwood Security (Stephanie) and Stratus security.
- Informed: Redwood Sales (Marissa) and procurement.

If that mapping looks right I’ll mark it in the SOW and send an execution copy for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0245

Attachments: redwood_draft_sow_v1.pdf, commercial_summary.xlsx

Subject: Finalize: RACI & short checklist before SOW execution

Thanks team — quick confirmation so we can move to signatures tomorrow: 

Confirmed RACI for POC (4 weeks):
- Infra (Connectivity & Host): Responsible = Tom Park (Stratus), Consulted = Dylan Brooks (Redwood SE)
- App Integration & Prompts: Responsible = Alicia Gomez (Stratus), Accountable = Alicia for acceptance sign-off
- Security Review: Responsible = Stratus security (Priya on your side); Responsible = Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood) for providing SOC2 excerpts, KMS docs
- Procurement & Billing: Responsible = procurement@stratusmedia.com (Tom to coordinate), Accountable = Marissa Cole (Redwood) for commercial execution

Short checklist before SOW signature: 
1) Procurement route (credit vs invoice) — Tom/procurement to confirm.
2) Network allowlist & VPN windows scheduled — Tom to propose 2x 1-hour windows (we’ll mirror them).
3) Data retention set to 30 days for the trial (confirmed by Alicia).
4) Stephanie will upload SOC2 excerpt and KMS rotation note to the Drive folder by EOD.
5) Marissa to send DocuSign SOW once procurement route is confirmed.

If no objections or edits, Marissa — please send the DocuSign and I’ll stand by to validate the connectivity test once you confirm signature.

Cheers,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
